import pytest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Test for VIRTUA-2.5-2: Derived Entity Patient Appointment
def test_patient_appointment_entity():
    from entities import PatientAppointment  # Assume entity class exists
    appointment = PatientAppointment(patient_id="P123", appointment_date=datetime.now())
    assert appointment.patient_id == "P123"
    assert hasattr(appointment, "appointment_date")

# Test for VIRTUA-2.5-3: Workflow routes to Doctors
def test_workflow_routes_to_doctor():
    from workflow import route_consultation_request
    mock_request = MagicMock(patient_id="P123", symptoms=["fever"])
    mock_doctor = MagicMock(id="D456")
    with patch("workflow.get_available_doctors", return_value=[mock_doctor]):
        result = route_consultation_request(mock_request)
        assert result.doctor_id == "D456"

# Test for VIRTUA-2.5-4: Workflow routes to Chemist by Pincode
def test_workflow_routes_to_chemist_by_pincode():
    from workflow import route_consultation_request
    mock_request = MagicMock(patient_id="P123", patient_pincode="12345")
    mock_chemist = MagicMock(id="C789", pincode="12345")
    with patch("workflow.get_chemists_by_pincode", return_value=[mock_chemist]):
        result = route_consultation_request(mock_request, route_to="chemist")
        assert result.chemist_id == "C789"

# Test for VIRTUA-2.5-5: ML algorithm predicts disease
def test_ml_algorithm_predicts_disease():
    from ml_model import predict_disease
    symptoms = ["cough", "fever"]
    prediction = predict_disease(symptoms)
    assert prediction.disease in ["Flu", "Common Cold"]  # As specified in training data

# Test for VIRTUA-2.5-6: ML algorithm trains on emerging data
def test_ml_algorithm_trains_on_new_data():
    from ml_model import train_model
    mock_new_data = [{"symptoms": ["headache"], "disease": "Migraine"}]
    with patch("ml_model._update_model") as mock_update:
        train_model(mock_new_data)
        mock_update.assert_called_once_with(mock_new_data)

# Test for VIRTUA-2.5-7: Database maintained by Admin
def test_database_connection_to_admin_db():
    from db import get_database_connection
    conn = get_database_connection()
    assert conn.database_name == "admin_db"  # As specified in requirement

# Test for VIRTUA-2.5-8: Patient archived after 3 years
def test_patient_archiving_after_3_years():
    from archiving import should_archive_patient
    last_consultation = datetime.now() - timedelta(days=3*365 + 1)  # 3 years + 1 day
    assert should_archive_patient(last_consultation) is True

# Test for VIRTUA-2.5-9: System capacity configuration
def test_system_capacity_configuration():
    from config import MAX_REQUESTS_PER_WEEK
    assert MAX_REQUESTS_PER_WEEK >= 25000  # As specified in requirement
